central_idea_and_construction: A thoughtful paper-goods name with a flowing rhythm of broad round bowls and soft bracketed serifs. Set exactly OFFCUT in one line; the O and C are generous oval forms, the F pair has shortened upper arms to keep open gaps, U has a deep curved basin, T has a softly flared top. Medium weight and low-to-moderate stroke contrast; serif feet curve into stems. One small identifying choice is the soft inward curl of the C terminal. Optical kerning, not rigid equal spacing. All six letters stay separate and clearly readable. No added symbol. Overall horizontal lettering occupies 78% of the canvas width, calm central placement.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Rounded O/C bowls and the rhythm of two F letters.
specific_risk: Overdecorated terminals or heavy uppercase could bring back the rejected industrial feel.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing actual output.
